top_signals.title: Iran War Leaves Europe Vulnerable To Harsh Winter
top_signals.summary:
With little gas in storage and prices surging, Europe is holding its breath for a mild winter.

Nicole Sy explains. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Sixth Street CEO Warns AI Race Rife With ‘Speculative Behaviors’
top_signals.summary: Sixth Street Partners Chief Executive Officer Alan Waxman said he sees growing signs of upheaval in the artificial intelligence boom, prompting the firm to stay largely on the sidelines.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
